WITH first_v AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member
)
SELECT f.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.format, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.valid_from <> f.join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) first_vf_ne_jd
FROM first_v f LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=f.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE f.rn=1 AND f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) dup_vf,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)<>1)) bad_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03') total_new,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member x WHERE x.member_id=m.member_id AND x.valid_from=m.join_date)) nofirst

WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT f.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_id) AS new_members
FROM first_version f
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = f.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE f.version_no = 1
  AND f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
